m.s: Bring a big pot of well-salted water to the boil. Cook {pasta} until al dente, then scoop out a mug of the cooking water before draining.
Thinly slice {garlic} and {chilli}. Halve {cherrytom}. Zest and juice {lemon}, and chop {parsley}.
Heat a generous glug of oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Sizzle the garlic and chilli for 1 minute until fragrant. Don't let the garlic brown or it goes bitter.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until they start to burst. Turn the heat up, add {prawns} and cook for 1 to 2 minutes a side until just pink and curled.
Add the drained pasta, {butter}, the lemon zest and juice and a splash of the pasta water. Toss hard for a minute until the sauce turns glossy and clings to the pasta.
Finish with the parsley and a pinch of {chilliflakes}, and serve straight away.

l: Reheat gently with a splash of water. Prawns are best eaten within a day. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
g: GF pasta in a separate pot, tossed in its own pan with a share of the prawns.
